t: The Saxby AmazonPro LED bulkhead light is a versatile lighting solution, suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications. This all-in-one emergency light features a slim, round profile and offers 3 selectable LED colour temperatures (3000K, 4000K, 6000K) and 3 wattages, providing adaptable illumination for commercial and public spaces like corridors and stairwells. Its integrated emergency kit ensures maintained or non-maintained operation for 3 hours. An IP65 rating provides robust protection against dust and water ingress. Installation is straightforward due to the fast-fit hinged gear tray and push-fit connector.
b: Fast-Fit Hinged Gear Tray & Push-Fit Connector
